title: 请求同事帮忙时，怎样给出明确期限和上下文
topic: 读 PostHog 员工沟通手册，练习回应请求时确认交付时间，并把讨论放在可追踪的位置。

source.title: Communication
source.section: Our communication values and golden rules
source.type: PostHog 公开的公司沟通手册
paragraphs: Use asynchronous communication when possible: pull requests or issues. Announcements happen on the appropriate Slack channels and people should be able to do their work without getting interrupted by chat.
Discussion in GitHub issues or pull requests is preferred. If you need a response urgently, send a link and ask for a response there.
When someone asks for something, reply back with a deadline or by noting that you already did it. Answers like “will do,” “OK,” or “it is on my todo list” are not helpful.
translations: 尽可能使用异步沟通：通过 pull request 或 issue 交流。公告发在合适的 Slack 频道，让同事可以不被聊天打断地工作。
优先在 GitHub issue 或 pull request 讨论。如果需要紧急回复，就附上链接并请对方在对应位置回复。
收到请求时，要回复预计完成时间，或者说明已经完成。只说“会做”“好的”或“在待办里”都不够有用。
fullTextParagraphs: With team members across many countries, it’s important for us to practice clear communication in ways that help us stay connected and work more efficiently.
Assume positive intent. Always come from a position of positivity and grace.
Form an opinion. We live in different locations and often have very different perspectives. We want to know your thoughts, opinions, and feelings on things.
Feedback is essential. Help everyone improve in a direct but constructive way.

Use asynchronous communication when possible: pull requests or issues. Announcements happen on the appropriate Slack channels and people should be able to do their work without getting interrupted by chat.
Discussion in GitHub issues or pull requests is preferred. If you need a response urgently, send a link and ask for a response there.
You are not expected to be available all the time. There is no expectation to respond to messages outside of your planned working hours.
When someone asks for something, reply back with a deadline or by noting that you already did it. Answers like “will do,” “OK,” or “it is on my todo list” are not helpful.
verifiedFacts: PostHog 的公开材料介绍了本课练习的工作做法。
练习场景为虚构训练，不代表公司真实员工对话。

notes.explain: when possible 表示优先异步，但不是绝对禁止会议或即时沟通。
notes.example: When possible, discuss this asynchronously in the issue.

notes.phrase: If you need a response urgently
notes.explain: 如果确实急需回复，应附上工作链接并在可追踪的 issue 或 PR 中说明。
notes.example: If you need a response urgently, please send me the link.

notes.explain: 收到请求后说清何时完成，或说明已经完成；只回“好的”无法帮助对方安排工作。
notes.example: I’ll send you a first draft by tomorrow afternoon.

scenario.title: PostHog工作场景练习（虚构）
english: A teammate asks you to review a launch checklist. You can complete it tomorrow afternoon, but the request came through a busy chat channel without a link to the checklist.
Reply with a clear deadline, ask for the working link, and suggest keeping review comments in the issue.
chinese: 同事请你审核上线清单。你可以明天下午完成，但请求发在很忙的聊天频道里，也没有清单链接。
回复明确的完成时间、请对方发工作链接，并建议把审核意见留在 issue 中。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请回复同事：你会在明天下午前审核客户通知；请对方发最新版文档链接；修改建议放在该 issue 里。
firstAttempt.sample: I can review the customer notice by 3 p.m. tomorrow. Could you send me the latest document link? I’ll leave my suggestions in the issue so the team can track them.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先给出关键背景和动作，再说明责任人与时间。

structure.original: When someone asks for something, reply back with a deadline or by noting that you already did it.
analysis: 用 I can... by... 确认交付时间，用 Could you share... 索取上下文，再说明反馈会留在哪里。
迁移时补上新的工作对象、负责人和明确期限。
structure.transfer: I can check the vendor summary by Friday morning. Could you share the latest link? I’ll add comments in the shared document so the project team can review them.

rewrite.good: I can review the refund guide by EOD Thursday. Could you share the current version? I’ll record my suggestions in the project issue so everyone can find them.
rewrite.translation: 我能在周四下班前审核退款指南。请发我当前版本，我会把建议记在项目 issue 里，方便团队查阅。
rewrite.pattern: State the context, propose a clear action, and name the owner or deadline.
